# Tokeni Bar

> Tokeni Bar is a native macOS menu-bar app that shows verified AI coding
> usage and turns verified cumulative token growth into a local virtual-pet
> experience.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/90ms/tokeni-bar

## Documentation

  English version of the primary overview.
- [Tokeni companion guide, Korean](https://github.com/90ms/tokeni-bar/blob/main/docs/bytebot.ko.md):

## Current companion facts

- Growth is provider-neutral and derives only from verified cumulative token
  observations. Active minutes affect presentation, never growth.
- One action energy is awarded per 50,000 verified tokens. Sub-threshold
  remainders and unspent energy carry forward.
- The menu popover always shows the companion card; it is not collapsible.
- Bond levels 2 through 5 grant one-time, per-generation rewards: a 2x
  30-minute booster, a 3x 20-minute booster, Firefly Aura, and a 5x 10-minute
  booster plus Orbit Aura.
- A timed booster multiplies only newly awarded base action energy. Only one
  booster can be active.
- Cosmetic slots are Aura, Background, and Body Color. There is no Head slot.
- Refund, asset-reset, and companion migration-reserve features are not part of
  the current product. Legacy Azure and Legacy Violet are names of current
  body-color assets.
- Companion state never contains provider names, token totals, prompts,
  responses, or credentials.

## Source layout

- `Sources/TokeniCore`: provider-neutral models, scanners, adapters, and
  companion engines.
- `Sources/TokeniBar`: macOS menu-bar UI and app state.
- `Tests/TokeniCoreTests`: parser and core behavior tests with sanitized
  fixtures.
- `packaging`: app-bundle and Homebrew templates.
